mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit WHERE DATE(CONVERT_TZ(visit_time, '+00:00', '+09:00')) = DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+09:00'))

SELECT x.dt AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TZ(visit_time, '+00:00', '+09:00')) AS dt FROM visit WHERE CONVERT_TZ(visit_time, '+00:00', '+09:00') >= DATE_SUB(DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+09:00')), INTERVAL 6 DAY) ) x GROUP BY x.dt ORDER BY x.dt
